name: Input
description: A styled text input component that extends the native HTML input element. Supports all standard input attributes via React.ComponentProps<"input"> and merges custom classes via the cn utility. Includes focus ring, placeholder, disabled, and file-input styles.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged with the default input styles via cn().

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML input attributes are forwarded (placeholder, disabled, value, onChange, name, etc.).

accessibility.role: Native input element with implicit textbox role.
accessibility.keyboard: Standard input keyboard behavior: Tab to focus, type to enter text.
accessibility.aria: Supports all standard aria-* attributes via spread props. Pair with a Label component for accessible labelling.
accessibility.notes: Disabled state reduces opacity to 50% and changes cursor to not-allowed. Focus ring uses ring-2 with ring-ring color and ring-offset-2.

recommendations.description: El componente Input debe ir acompañado de una etiqueta (Label) para describir su propósito.
Evitar agregar un ícono dentro del Input si no aporta valor significativo o en formularios donde hay demasiados campos.
